title: Wiemer hero (v2)
description: A full-bleed photo hero, a window tall on phones and one and a half windows on desktop: a huge light wordmark centred near the top with a two-line subline, and at the bottom a thin hairline, a caption left and a small promo card right. The photo drifts slowly as you scroll.
notes: pair with wiemer-v2-header (overlay variant) floating on top
the text uses the background colour over a dark placeholder; with a real photo keep it dark enough for light text
phones show only the photo by default, as the original does (textOnPhones shows the rest)
the parallax is CSS scroll-driven; without support the photo just sits still
